g.text: Just mentally though... are you okay ?
PlantUML (1.2022.7) cannot parse result from dot/GraphViz.
This version of PlantUML is 1171 days old, so you should
Please go to https://plantuml.com/graphviz-dot to check your GraphViz version.
You should send this diagram and this image to
You can try to turn arround this issue by simplifing your diagram.
